strings.no_moves_help: Use Shuffle or Undo, or go back to the last solvable point.
strings.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.error_content: The puzzles couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
strings.error_level_unavailable: That puzzle isn't available. Taking you home.
strings.save_recovered: Your progress was restored from a backup.
strings.all_levels_done: Every level completed - replay any you like!
strings.all_discoveries_found: Every discovery found. Thank you for playing!
strings.tile_blocked_help: That tile is blocked. You can pick a tile when nothing is on top of it and its left or right side is free.
strings.hint_unverified: Here's a matching pair. There wasn't time to check further ahead.
strings.hint_dead: No pair here can still clear the board. Try Undo or Shuffle, or go back to the last solvable point.
strings.stuck_banner: This board can't be finished from here. Use Undo or Shuffle, or go back to keep playing.
strings.rescue_body: Shuffle rearranges the remaining tiles into a layout that can be solved. Going back to the last solvable point and restarting are always free.
strings.shuffle_failed_body: The remaining tiles are stacked so that no arrangement can be cleared. You can go back to the last solvable point or restart - both are free.
strings.rewind_checkpoint: Go back to last solvable point
strings.restart_confirm_body: The current board starts over. Your completed levels and Lights are kept.
strings.replay_no_light: Replays are just for fun - Lights come from new boards.

lights_to_next.one: {count} more Light to your next discovery
lights_to_next.other: {count} more Lights to your next discovery

strings.world_locked_hint: Complete level {level} to open this world.
strings.bloom_tap_hint: Tap a discovery to learn its story.

daily_archive_note.one: Puzzles from the last {count} day stay playable. There are no streaks - play whenever you like.
daily_archive_note.other: Puzzles from the last {count} days stay playable. There are no streaks - play whenever you like.

strings.tasks_claim_locked: Finish all three to claim today's Light.
strings.tasks_no_pressure: Optional. Missed days are fine - nothing resets.
strings.tile_back_equipped: New boards now flip from the {world} back.
strings.shop_error: The store can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
strings.product_remove_ads_desc: Turns off all optional ad breaks. Never affects gameplay.
strings.product_theme_bundle_desc: Unlocks the Sakura, Ocean and Nocturne tile themes right away.
strings.purchase_success_body: Your purchase is ready to enjoy.
strings.purchase_pending_body: Your payment is being processed. The item will unlock once the store confirms it.
strings.purchase_failed_body: No charge was made by the game. Please try again later.
strings.vibration_note: Vibration works on phones and tablets.
strings.graphics_note: Low uses lighter backgrounds and fewer effects to save battery.
strings.large_tiles_note: Keeps tiles big on large boards; drag to move around the board.
strings.highlight_free_note: Tiles you can't pick yet are shown slightly darker.
strings.show_timer_note: A personal statistic only. Time never affects anything.
strings.link_not_configured_note: This link will be added before release.
strings.analytics_note_off: This version doesn't collect any usage statistics.
strings.analytics_note_on: Optional. Helps us improve puzzles. You can change this anytime.
strings.reset_progress_note: Erases progress, coins and boosters stored on this device. Store purchases like Remove Ads can be restored; purchased coins can't.
strings.reset_confirm_body: Completed levels, Lights, discoveries, coins, boosters and daily records on this device will be erased. This can't be undone.
strings.licenses_body: Game art, sounds and puzzles were created originally for LiShi Mahjong. Rubik font: SIL Open Font License 1.1, The Rubik Project Authors. Built with the Godot Engine (MIT license).
strings.tut_step_tray: Tap a tile to send it to the tray. Two identical tiles in the tray burst! Try the glowing tiles.
strings.tut_step_stack: You can pick a tile when nothing is on top of it and its left or right side is free. A tile with neighbours on both sides waits until one side opens.
strings.tut_step_full: The tray holds 4 tiles. If it fills up without a pair, the round is lost - so look for twins before you tap.
strings.tut_step_bonus: Flowers and Seasons match only an identical tile: same picture, same color.
strings.tut_ready: You're ready! Stuck? Use Hint, Undo or Shuffle - you start with a few and earn coins for more.
strings.story_stone_path: Smooth stones invite slow, unhurried walks.
strings.story_flower_bed: Every bloom here opened after a quiet match.
strings.story_sakura_tree: Its petals fall whenever someone smiles nearby.
strings.story_pond: The pond reflects the sky, and your calm.
strings.story_stone_lantern: It glows softly when the garden needs it.
strings.story_butterfly: A visitor that only stays where it feels peaceful.
strings.story_blossom_pink: Pink blossoms for every gentle morning.
strings.story_wooden_fence: Not to keep anyone out - just to lean on.
strings.story_bridge: A small bridge for small, happy steps.
strings.story_pagoda: A place to rest between puzzles.
strings.story_shell: Hold it close and you'll hear the waves.
strings.story_rocks: Polished by a thousand patient tides.
strings.story_coral: Coral grows slowly and beautifully, like good habits.
strings.story_pearl: A treasure formed by time and care.
strings.story_grass_patch: The breeze plays here all afternoon.
strings.story_shrub: A cozy hideaway for sea birds.
strings.story_leaf_tree: Its shade makes the sunniest day gentle.
strings.story_lotus: It rises from still water, bright and calm.
strings.story_blossom_white: White blossoms, light as sea foam.
strings.story_lantern: A warm light for a peaceful night.
strings.story_crystal_cluster: The crystals hum softly under the moon.
strings.story_blossom_blue: Blue blossoms open only after dusk.
strings.story_maple_tree: Its leaves glow like embers in the moonlight.
strings.story_cherry_petals: Petals drift on the night air like quiet wishes.
strings.story_pagoda_night: Its windows glow for every traveller.
strings.story_bamboo: It bends in the wind and never breaks.
strings.story_koi: It circles the pond, bringing good luck.
strings.story_reeds: They hum softly when the breeze passes.
strings.story_chest: Full of small joys collected along the way.
strings.story_maple_leaves: They turn the colour of the setting sun.
strings.story_fan: One gentle wave cools the warmest evening.
strings.story_flower: It opens wide for the last light of the day.
strings.story_gem: It holds a little of the sunset inside.
strings.story_signboard: It welcomes every guest by name.
strings.story_snow_house: Warm windows glow behind the snow.
strings.story_snow_tree: It wears the first snow like a soft coat.
strings.story_snowflake: No two are alike, just like your games.
strings.story_cloud: It drifts slowly, scattering gentle snow.
strings.get_more_body: Get more with coins, or watch a short video.
strings.ad_unavailable: No video is available right now. Please try again later.
strings.shop_restore_note: Purchased coins stay on this device and can't be restored after a reset.
strings.shop_iap_note: Purchases are optional. Every level can be finished without paying.
strings.product_starter_bundle_desc: Coins: {coins} · Hints: {hint} · Shuffles: {shuffle} · Undos: {undo} · No more ads
strings.welcome_body: Hint, Shuffle and Undo now come as boosters you earn with coins. Thank you for playing - here is a gift. Coins: {coins} · Hints: {hint} · Shuffles: {shuffle} · Undos: {undo}
strings.new_levels_body: Every world now has 100 levels. Level numbers changed to make room, and your progress, stars and rewards moved with them. You continue where you left off, and the new levels in worlds you have already played wait on the world map.
strings.consent_body: LiShi Mahjong is free thanks to ads. With your OK, our ad partners (Unity LevelPlay and Meta Audience Network) can use your device's advertising ID to show ads that suit you and to measure them. If you decline, you still see ads, just less personal ones. The game plays the same either way, and you can change this anytime in Settings.
strings.tray_full_body: The tray is full and has no pair in it.
strings.tut_tray_full: Tray full! The tiles go back - try picking twins.
strings.extra_slot_desc: Adds one more slot to the tray for this level.
strings.play_with_extra_slot: Play with an Extra Slot ({count} left)
strings.streak_lost: Your win streak of {count} has ended.
strings.restart_ends_streak: Restarting ends your win streak of {count}.
strings.streak_bonus_slot: Win streak {count}: this level starts with an extra slot!
strings.streak_slot_unlocked: Streak of 3! New levels now start with an extra slot.
strings.duet_intro: Two players, one board, one tray. Clear it together!
strings.duet_rule_turns: Take turns: one tile each, then pass the phone.
strings.duet_rule_pairs: Finish your partner's pair for a Team-up bonus.
strings.duet_rule_tray: The tray is shared. If it fills up, you try again together.
strings.duet_use_code_board: You will play this Studio board:
strings.free_play_note: Helpers on these boards are free, a few per board. No coins are used.
strings.board_preparing: Preparing a board that can be cleared…
strings.duet_tray_full_body: The tray is full and has no pair in it. Try another order together!
strings.free_hints_used_up: No hints left on this board.
strings.free_undos_used_up: No undos left on this board.
strings.free_play_out_body: You have used this board’s free helpers. You can go back to the last solvable point or start the board again.
strings.studio_share_text: Try my LiShi Mahjong board! Board Studio → Enter code: {code}
strings.studio_checking: Checking that the board can be cleared…
strings.studio_impossible: These settings don't make a board that can be cleared. Try fewer tiles or another shape.
strings.studio_ready_body: Our solver checked it: this board can be cleared.
strings.studio_adjusted_seed: We picked a close variation so the board can be cleared.

studio_adjusted_tiles.one: We used {count} tile so the board can be cleared.
studio_adjusted_tiles.other: We used {count} tiles so the board can be cleared.

strings.studio_small_tiles: Tiles will be small on this board.

studio_full.one: My boards is full ({count}). Delete a board to save new ones.
studio_full.other: My boards is full ({count}). Delete a board to save new ones.

strings.studio_mine_empty: No boards yet. Create one, or enter a friend's code.
strings.studio_delete_body: It is removed from My boards. Anyone who has the code can still play it.
strings.studio_code_intro: Enter the code a friend shared with you.
strings.code_err_empty: Type or paste a code first.
strings.code_err_length: A board code has 8 letters and numbers after LS, like LS-7K2M-9QRT.
strings.code_err_chars: That code has a character that isn't used in board codes.
strings.code_err_checksum: That code doesn't look right. Check it for a typo.
strings.code_err_version: This code is from a newer version of the game. Update the app to play it.
strings.code_err_board: This code doesn't make a board.
strings.restore_failed: Couldn't reach the store. Please try again later.
